PR #31252 (#30916) changed `scripts/adr-index.mjs --report`: a Date, Supersedes or Superseded-by cell that the committed index carried and the regeneration empties now exits 1 (triage ruling 6685367873: "hardens an existing check and adds no new gate"). Raised by the #30916 card thread as an open question; kept out of that PR because `.github/workflows/lint.yml` is governed rules text and the PR was not.

## Measured on `main` `bdefd49f3`

- `.github/workflows/lint.yml` line 693: "…exits 0 whatever it finds. So the only red this step can show is a broken generator, never a record."
- Line 697: step name `ADR index is current (report-only — warnings, never a red on a record)`.
- `scripts/adr-index.mjs` `reportExitCode` returns 1 when `dropped.length > 0`. A record edit that removes a header field without regenerating the index reds this step, so the comment and the name no longer describe it.

## Ask

Reword the comment block (lines 687–696) and the step name so they say what the step does now: warnings exit 0, except a dropped field, which exits 1. Change no step behaviour and no `id`. If a pin or a step-name census reads the name, move it in the same PR.
